Three questions define the work. Is the mechanism well supported? What has actually been established about how this intervention is meant to work, and what has only been assumed. Does the mechanism operate in patients? Human genetics, expression, cohort and prior-trial evidence all bear on whether the biology that works in a model system is present, and rate-limiting, in the population being treated.
